About us

PM SHRI Higher Primary School in Maraluru, Tumkur, teaches children from LKG to 7th standard. Our teachers focus on strong reading, writing and number skills in the early years, and on science, languages and confidence in the upper classes.

LKG–7thclasses offered
MaraluruTumkur district, Karnataka

Special classes at our school

Computer classes

Hands-on practice with typing, drawing and basic computer skills.

AI classes

Simple, fun lessons that show children what artificial intelligence is and how to use it safely.

Smart classes

Lessons taught with digital screens, videos and animations to make ideas easy to see.

Yoga classes

Daily breathing and yoga to help children stay calm, strong and focused.

Dance classes

Folk and classical dance, and practice for cultural programmes.

Karate classes

Self-defence, discipline and fitness for boys and girls.

Boxing classes

Basic boxing training for strength, fitness and confidence.

Mehendi classes

Learning mehendi designs, a creative skill for festivals and celebrations.

Academics

LKG and UKG

Learning through play, songs, stories and early letters and numbers.

1st to 3rd standard

Reading, writing, basic maths and learning about nature.

4th and 5th standard

Stronger language skills, environmental studies and group projects.

6th and 7th standard

Science, maths, social science and languages, with preparation for high school.

Student achievements

Two bronze medals at the state-level boxing meet

At the 2026–27 state-level school sports boxing competition in Shivamogga, organised by the Department of School Education, our students Dhanush Rao (30–32 kg) and Ajmal Pasha (44–46 kg) won bronze medals. Education officers praised the win, and the school thanks boxing trainer Monika and team manager Praveen Kumar M.B. for their effort.
